articles.title: Free $1,000 for Babies? Trump Accounts Are Here, But Some Families Are Still Waiting
articles.summary: President Trump is giving $1,000 to babies born during his term. Over 6.5 million kids have signed up, but some parents say the money hasn't shown up yet. They're told it could take weeks.

articles.title: The Reflecting Pool Drama: Algae, Arrests, and a $14 Million Makeover
articles.summary: The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in D.C. was supposed to get a quick, cheap makeover. Instead, it's turned into a months-long reality show with green algae, peeling paint, arrests, and a price tag over $14 million.

articles.title: Bus Rides for Just £2! England Caps Fares to Help with Living Costs
articles.summary: Starting in January, most bus rides in England will cost no more than £2. The government says it will help people save money, but some worry that rural areas still don't have enough buses.
